recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It directly applies FHIR-23729 while preserving later _elements decisions; no separate commit is needed in this run for FHIR-27054, FHIR-25279, or FHIR-31655.
issue_request: FHIR-23729 was Published as Persuasive for R5 and asked to allow _elements dotted paths, clarify that the selection applies to the resources returned rather than the Bundle wrapper, and say that parent elements leading to a selected nested element are included.
initial_application: No FHIR-23729-tagged implementation commit was found. The source still contained the original root-level-only _elements wording from the historical #7540 addition. FHIR-22934, an earlier no-change issue on the same dotted-path ambiguity, explicitly said it was superseded by GF23729. FHIR-27054 later applied only the included-resource/type-prefix portion of the same _elements syntax family.
additional_context: FHIR-27054 added the Patient.gender resource-type-prefixed rule for included resources; FHIR-25279 constrains _elements choice-type references to the base element name; and FHIR-31655 clarifies returned mandatory/modifier elements and server discretion. The 2019 implementers Zulip thread matches the seed's version-id history use case, while the 2020 FHIR-27054 thread and FHIR-I minutes show the included-resource change as related but distinct.
reconciliation: Edited source/search.html in the _elements section to replace root-only wording with element names or dotted element paths, define dotted paths relative to returned resources rather than the search/history Bundle, add a meta.versionId example, state that parent elements are included when nested elements are returned, and preserve the existing choice-element and included-resource guidance.
source_changes: source/search.html: clarified _elements syntax to allow dotted element paths relative to returned resources, not the enclosing Bundle, and to include parent elements for nested returns.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-23729 superseded the earlier no-change issue about dotted _elements paths, so the root-only interpretation was no longer controlling.
FHIR-27054 added resource-type-prefixed _elements restrictions for included resources in the same source section, but did not address nested dotted paths.
FHIR-25279 constrains choice-type references in _elements to base element names; the new dotted-path text preserves that rule for path components.
FHIR-31655 clarified expected returned mandatory/modifier elements and server discretion in the same paragraph family; this fix preserves that later wording.
